title: Configure Style Dictionary v4, Tokens Studio, and Figma Code Connect pipelines cleanly

contextSnapshot.surface: cross-platform design system synced between Figma and Web/iOS/Android
contextSnapshot.platform: Style Dictionary v4 + Figma Code Connect

prompt: Set up a Style Dictionary v4 build pipeline for DTCG tokens with semantic CSS references and Figma Code Connect mappings for our Button component.
forbiddenBehaviors: mixes legacy value/type and DTCG $value/$type tokens in the same Style Dictionary v4 instance
hand-edits generated dist/tokens.css output instead of source token JSON
flattens semantic CSS variables without outputReferences when runtime theme switching is needed

rubricDimensions.pass: uses consistent DTCG $value/$type (usesDtcg: true), outputReferences for semantic CSS var chains, and @tokens-studio/sd-transforms when using Tokens Studio
rubricDimensions.fail: mixes DTCG and legacy token formats or loses semantic variable references

rubricDimensions.pass: maps Figma properties via figma.connect with figma.enum/boolean/string/children to real component props and validates in CI
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes static non-mapped snippets or omits CI validation

rubricDimensions.pass: treats compiled platform files as generated build outputs and validates references in CI
rubricDimensions.fail: instructs developers to patch generated CSS/Swift/Kotlin token files manually

negativeControls.name: mixed dtcg and legacy tokens
negativeControls.input: put both $value and legacy value keys inside the same Style Dictionary v4 config
negativeControls.mustNot: approve mixing legacy value/type and DTCG $value/$type in one Style Dictionary v4 instance

negativeControls.name: manual edit of generated tokens
negativeControls.input: edit dist/tokens.css directly to tweak the dark mode accent color
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend hand-editing generated token build outputs

baseline.withoutSkill: mixes DTCG/legacy token syntax, flattens CSS references, and omits Code Connect CI checks
baseline.withSkill: configures pure DTCG Style Dictionary v4 with outputReferences, typed Figma Code Connect mappings, and CI validation
